## Core Idea

A generic nonlinear system may be written as

$$
\dot{x}=f(x,y), \qquad 0=g(x,y).
$$

$$
\mathbf{H}_{G}
=
\begin{pmatrix}
\mathbf{0} & \mathbf{G} \\
\mathbf{G}^{\dagger} & \mathbf{0}
\end{pmatrix}.
$$

$$
\mathbf{G} = \sum_{k=0}^{T-1}|k\rangle \langle k|\otimes\mathbf{I} -\sum_{k=1}^{T-1}|k\rangle \langle k-1|\otimes(\mathbf{I}+\mathbf{A}\Delta t),
$$
After model transformation, one may obtain a polynomial system

$$
\dot{z}=A_1z+A_2z^{\otimes 2}+\cdots+A_Rz^{\otimes R}.
$$
